issue.title: test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member fails deterministically since @small dropped its Antigravity member
issue.description:
tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py::TestHandlePossibleUsageLimit::test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member
fails deterministically on clean master HEAD 630f4ea71 (verified via `git stash` in
workspace sase_22, no local changes present, isolated rerun: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest
tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py::TestHandlePossibleUsageLimit::test_agy_captured_failure_disables_small_pool_member`
-> 1 failed).

Failure: `StopIteration` at
tests/test_llm_provider_usage_limit_disable.py:202 in
`agy_member = next(member for member in details.members if member.target == agy_target)`
where `agy_target = "agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high"` and
`details = model_alias_selector_details(SMALL_MODEL_ALIAS_NAME)`.

Root cause: commit 630f4ea71 "fix(llm-provider): restore Gemini 3.7 Flash High to
@xsmall only" (SASE_PLAN=202608/restore_gemini_xsmall_only.md, a tale plan, not an
epic) edited src/sase/llm_provider/model_alias_defaults.yml so `@small`'s target no
longer includes `agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high` (it moved exclusively to `@xsmall`). The
commit updated its own new/changed regression tests but missed this pre-existing test,
which still asserts that disabling agy on a usage-limit error removes
`agy/gemini-3.7-flash-high` from the `@small` pool.

Impact: blocks `just check`/`just check-full`'s scoped and full test lanes for every
agent regardless of diff, whenever this node is selected or the full suite runs.
Discovered while implementing the unrelated plan
sase/repos/plans/202608/finalizer_staged_bead_state.md (only touches
src/sase/bead/_sync_git.py and src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer_*.py plus new/
updated tests under tests/test_bead/ and tests/llm_provider/).

Likely fix: update the test to target a small-pool member that still exists after
630f4ea71 (e.g. one of the Claude/Codex/Grok high-effort members), or repoint its
Antigravity-specific assertion at `@xsmall` instead of `@small`, matching the new
model_alias_defaults.yml topology.
